description: Night photograph, apparently taken from a phone, of an illuminated building-mounted clock above a tall red LED sign displaying white Chinese characters reading vertically. The sign shows a stylized logo character, small English text 'CAPITAL MEDIA', and the characters 京城传媒 (Jingcheng Chuanmei, 'Capital City Media'), suggesting the photo was taken in Beijing, China. A dark high-rise office tower with a few lit windows stands behind; the clock reads approximately 6:32.
flags: Location inferred from Chinese signage, not independently verified

description: Cartoon image of Pepe the Frog's head, grinning with mouth open, with a black letter 'Q' drawn in each eye. Pepe is an internet meme character widely used on 4chan/8chan; here it is adapted as a QAnon emblem. Transparent/white background, no other content.
flags: Pepe the Frog is used across many contexts, including as a hate symbol in some usages; here it appears as a QAnon-branded meme

description: Dark grid infographic (7 rows x 3 columns) of black-and-white portrait photos of former FBI and DOJ officials, each labeled with name and title and overlaid with a red grunge 'FIRED' stamp (one cell, Randy Coleman, bears a partially legible different red stamp reading 'RE—D', possibly 'REASSIGNED' or 'REMOVED'). Several individuals appear twice (Josh Campbell, John Carlin, Mary McCord). The graphic presents these departures as firings; several listed officials in fact resigned, were reassigned, or left voluntarily.

Several titles are inaccurately prefixed 'FORMER FBI' for DOJ officials (Yates, McCord, Brand, Carlin)
